improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

I require you to serve as a sophisticated domain name generator. I will clearly describe the nature of my business or project, and your task is to generate a list of domain name alternatives that accurately reflect the given concept. 

Your response should meet the following criteria:

1. Maximum domain length: 7-8 characters
2. Uniqueness: Avoid common or overused names
3. Catchiness: Feel free to suggest creative, unconventional words
4. Relevance: The domain should relate to the description I provide
5. Format: List the domain names without any additional explanation

To initiate, I will provide the description of my business or idea. Please acknowledge your understanding by replying "OK, I understand the requirements" before proceeding. Then, I will share the details of my concept. After receiving the information, wait for at least 10 seconds before generating the domain name list.

Ensure there are no gaps in the list, and that each domain is presented clearly, separated by line breaks for easy reading. Do not write any narrative or explanation outside of the domain names themselves.

Please confirm your understanding and readiness to proceed by replying "OK, I understand the requirements and will await your description."
